question: 统计一笔缴款收了多少钱时，应该按缴款通知书票面的总金额算，还是按各征收项目的金额明细算？
sql:
SELECT
    count() AS n_tickets,
    countIf(abs(sum_dedup - ftotalamt) < 0.001) AS n_match,
    countIf(abs(sum_dedup - ftotalamt) >= 0.001) AS n_mismatch,
    round(sumIf(sum_dedup - ftotalamt, abs(sum_dedup - ftotalamt) >= 0.001), 2) AS mismatch_amt_total
FROM (
    SELECT
        fpid,
        sum(famt_latest) AS sum_dedup,
        any(ftotalamt) AS ftotalamt
    FROM (
        SELECT
            i.fpid AS fpid,
            argMax(i.famt, i.fupdatetime) AS famt_latest,
            any(p.ftotalamt) AS ftotalamt
        FROM une_paybook_item_new i
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT fid, ftotalamt
            FROM une_paybook_new
            WHERE fstate = '3'
        ) p ON i.fpid = p.fid
        GROUP BY i.fpid, i.fid
    )
    GROUP BY fpid
)
answer:
实测结论与口径规则已沉淀到记忆中，供后续会话复用。

**一句话回答你的问题**：统计一笔缴款收了多少钱，**以征收项目明细 `famt` 合计为准**（按 `(fpid, fid)` 去重取最新版本），票面总额 `ftotalamt` 仅用于单票展示和对账校验——99.9% 的实缴票据两种口径一致，但明细口径才能暴露重复版本、脏数据这些让金额虚增的陷阱。
